results.title: Marigold Spring Victory Series 2026 ~ Day 6
results.overview: Marigold Spring Victory Series 2026 ~ Day 6 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Dream Star★Fighting Marigold. It took place on March 28, 2026 at Shinjuku FACE in Tokyo, Japan. In the main event, Mayu Iwatani defended the GHC Women's and Marigold Super Fly Championships against Natsumi Showzuki in a double-title match.

results.overview: Sofía returns home after her brother's death to find her father dying from a fascist regime's vaccine that targeted large families. As he deteriorates and the town runs dry, she desperately searches for a cure.

results.title: Chicken Tenders And Hard Liquor
results.overview: A college student gets too fond of a rotisserie chicken after a night of hard drinking, and wakes up to some unusual consequences.

results.title: Semeei Vermelho
results.overview: Teresa, a Catholic girl, is torn between the desire she thinks she feels for Maria, her long-time friend, and her faith, which she is no longer sure she has. Teresa is increasingly consumed by the world around her, by her confirmation dress and by the moment that is brewing in this closed space: the confession of her sin.

results.original_title: The Dark Knot at the Center
results.overview: Drawing from an archive of letters written in the 1960s, the film reimagines women's clandestine journeys from across the United States to Mexican border towns to access underground abortion care.

results.title: The Woman of the River
results.overview: Érica struggles to build a new life with her young daughter, Flor, but everything is threatened when Pedro, her ex-partner and Flor's father, is released from prison after three years. At first, everything seems fine, but the fragility is shattered when Pedro can't control his dark impulses, unleashing a family turmoil.

results.title: Bruvvas
results.overview: SHE's in a hole. Being with HE again is the only thing that can pull her out. As she re-enters the playground of their last morning together, she must accept that some endings can't be changed, baked beans or not.

results.title: American Dream
results.overview: In the lives of expatriates, the "American Dream" is not just a dream, but behind it lies struggle, sacrifice, and many unseen realities.

results.title: Dead Reset
results.overview: Trapped in an underwater research facility, surgeon Cole Mason is forced to operate on a mutating, parasitic creature. The catch? He’s trapped in a brutal, blood-soaked time loop and must relive his own violent demise over and over again. To survive, Cole must embrace death and find a way to kill the creature and stop the loop before he becomes trapped in a never ending spiral of horror.

Don't miss the epic action of "Ultraman Zero Cosmo Rise" as he wields the power of the Ultra Cosmo Records and the "UltRise Eye"—a brand-new item imbued with the legendary strength of generations of Ultra Heroes!

results.title: A Stab At Heaven
results.overview: A true story of an 18-year-old Ema McKie who, after receiving news that her fiancé has committed suicide, drives across the country to join him in death, losing her mind to find her truth and journey home.

results.title: Wild No More
results.overview: On the verge of divorce, Yawen works at a quiet suburban bowling alley. A group of women rent out the venue for a wild bachelorette party, ready to savor their freedom. After a flashy show, they prank Yawen by handcuffing her and a go-go boy together before taking off. Sharing the same space, the two seem connected, yet remain unable to truly connect.
